title: Four independent service hardening tickets
instruction:
Complete four independent tickets in this service monorepo. Units are disjoint: src/csv/, src/ratelimit/, src/cache/, src/semver/. No ticket depends on another; keep changes in its own module and add regression tests per ticket. Shared runtime and auxiliary module APIs should remain compatible. Use Node ESM/built-ins only; run node --test.

1. CSV: repair parseCsv(text,{delimiter=','}={}) in src/csv/index.mjs. Return string[][] with no trimming or type coercion. Empty input (or only a leading BOM) returns []; strip one leading U+FEFF only. Unquoted LF and CRLF end records; lone unquoted CR throws CSV_NEWLINE. Quoted fields may contain commas, delimiters, CR, LF and CRLF verbatim; doubled quotes decode to one quote. A quote may only open at field start; after its close only delimiter, record end or EOF is legal; stray/unterminated quotes throw CSV_QUOTE. Leading/trailing separators create empty fields. A final record terminator adds no phantom record; blank records are ['']; unequal row widths are accepted. Non-string text throws CSV_INPUT; delimiter must be one UTF-16 code unit other than quote, CR, LF or throw CSV_DELIMITER. Errors have .code.

2. Rate limit: createLimiter({limit,windowMs,burst=0,now}) returns {take(key,cost=1),reset(key)}. limit/windowMs positive safe integers, burst nonnegative safe integer, limit+burst safe, now function; otherwise LIMIT_CONFIG. Each nonempty string key has an independent sliding window with capacity limit+burst. Accepted costs are recorded at the injected clock time; records at <=now-windowMs expire, so boundary is inclusive. Burst is extra window capacity, NOT a token bucket or a second independent quota. take returns exactly {allowed,remaining,retryAfterMs}; accepted retry=0, remaining=capacity-active-cost; rejection records nothing, remaining=capacity-active and retry is the earliest delay at which enough recorded costs expire for THIS cost. Cost is a positive safe integer <=capacity; invalid key/cost throws LIMIT_INPUT before reading clock. now() must be a nonnegative safe integer and nondecreasing across all keys or CLOCK_INVALID. reset validates key, removes only that key and does not read/reset clock.

3. Cache: createCache({maxSize,ttlMs,staleMs=0,now,sizeOf=()=>1}) returns set/get/delete/clear/snapshot/getOrLoad. maxSize positive safe integer; TTL/stale nonnegative safe integers; now/sizeOf functions, else CACHE_CONFIG. Keys nonempty strings or CACHE_INPUT. Values are structured-cloneable; clone on input/output including loader results. sizeOf(detachedValue,key) returns positive safe integer or CACHE_SIZE (invalid size must not overwrite existing value). Account sizes, not entry count; evict least recently used entries until within maxSize. set refreshes age and MRU; successful fresh get and stale/fresh getOrLoad promote MRU; missing/stale get does not. Oversize set removes the previous key but caches nothing. snapshot returns exactly {count,size}. All public operations lazily purge entries at now >= inserted+ttlMs+staleMs. get returns value only while now < inserted+ttlMs, otherwise undefined. delete returns boolean; clear removes all. Clock is nonnegative safe integer and globally nondecreasing or CLOCK_INVALID. getOrLoad(key,loader) is async; loader must be function or CACHE_INPUT. Fresh returns without calling loader. Stale (ttl <=age<ttl+stale) returns detached stale value immediately AND starts a background refresh. Hard-expired/missing callers await load. Concurrent loads for same key coalesce; distinct keys do not. Successful load installs with TTL starting at completion; cold failures reject, background failures are suppressed and keep stale value until hard expiry; next call retries. set/delete/clear fence in-flight loads: their old result can resolve original callers but cannot install over newer state. Eviction/expiry alone does not cancel a pending load. Use promise barriers, not sleeps.

4. Semver: satisfies(version,range) in src/semver/index.mjs returns boolean. Strict versions have three nonnegative safe-integer components without leading zeros, optional dot-separated ASCII alphanumeric/hyphen prerelease identifiers (numeric identifiers have no leading zeros) and build identifiers (leading zeros allowed). Compare prereleases per semver: numeric numerically, numeric below nonnumeric, ASCII lexical otherwise, shorter prefix below longer, release above prerelease; ignore build. Invalid version throws SEMVER_VERSION. Ranges are nonempty strings: whitespace-separated comparator intersections, || unions, bare or = exact/partial versions, ^, ~, inclusive 'A - B' hyphen ranges with spaces, x/X/* wildcards (only suffix components). Full comparators > >= < <= require full versions. Partial 1 means >=1.0.0 <2.0.0; 1.2 means >=1.2.0 <1.3.0; * matches all releases. ~1 means <2.0.0, ~1.2[.3] means <1.3.0. Caret advances first nonzero component among specified components, or last specified zero: ^1.2.3 <2.0.0, ^0.2.3 <0.3.0, ^0.0.3 <0.0.4, ^0.0 <0.1.0, ^0 <1.0.0. Hyphen lower partial fills zeros, full upper inclusive, partial upper advances last specified component exclusively; wildcard endpoint is unbounded. ^*/~* are unbounded. Prerelease matches only if the SAME union clause explicitly mentions a prerelease comparator endpoint with identical major/minor/patch. No implicit prerelease admission from wildcards; prerelease is allowed only on full versions. Reject malformed tokens, empty union clauses, leading-zero components, nonsuffix wildcards, comma syntax, parentheses and unsupported syntax with SEMVER_RANGE. Parse every clause even if an earlier clause matches. Errors have .code.
